title: Ukraine war live: Zelenskyy to meet Trump in Florida for peace talks after Russia intensifies attacks on Kyiv
summary: Ukrainian president will meet US president at his Mar-a-Lago home later today for their first in person meeting since October We are restarting our live coverage of the war in Ukraine as Volodymyr Zelenskyy is due to meet Donald Trump for the latest round of diplomatic talks in Florida at about 1:00pm (18:00 GMT). Their meeting at the US president’s Mar-a-Lago home will be the pair’s first in-person encounter since October, when Trump refused to grant Zelenskyy’s request for long-range Tomahawk missiles .
